name: cl0q open-web index API (cl0q.com)
tier_rationale: Small operator (a single support mailbox, no company identity) until a promotion is recorded; council P018 cond 1 (legal_dpo, osint_investigator): unknown tier, never default, excluded at TLP:AMBER and above, --allow-unknown at CLEAR/GREEN (A8).

reliability.justification: Open-web crawl index; shared favicons and ASN neighbours are hypotheses (framework defaults, hosting), never ownership.

cl0q.description: cl0q API key (X-API-Key header only, never ?key=)
cl0q.plan_hint: business = a company/team account on a plan whose terms permit internal business use, recorded by legal (never an analyst's personal free account, P007 cond 3); key_plans.cl0q='business' unlocks it under the corporate profile

api.title: cl0q favicon and browse APIs (GET /api/favicon?domain=|hash=, GET /api/browse/asn/{asn})

terms.quote: P018 cond 2 (binding council text): key-terms - a company/team account on a plan recorded by legal before it runs under the corporate profile; the key travels only in the X-API-Key header, never as ?key= (the cache stores URLs).

api.notes: Research C0025 (verified_needs_key: 401 'missing API key'; real fixture). Docs read 2026-11-26: favicons are content-addressed by the SHA-256 of the icon bytes (not mmh3); free key 30/min and 1,000/day on favicon/subdomains/domain (quota block); 400 malformed hash, 401/403 missing or invalid key, 429 rate limited, 503 maintenance. Keys are minted by POST /api/signup, an automated sign-up that is never called (accounts are created by hand under the corporate identity); POST /api/watch (stores the query), /api/feedback and /api/report are never called. Used by cl0q.

notes: Owned by batch p3-G01-1 (P018, module cl0q).
